run_benchmarks: run MuJoCo Warp benchmarks from a local directory or git repository with a regex filter
run_benchmark_humanoid: run the humanoid benchmark with default settings from the current directory
view_benchmark_humanoid: open the humanoid benchmark in the mjwarp-viewer for visual inspection
run_benchmark_from_git: run MuJoCo Warp benchmarks from a remote git repository at a specific commit
run_benchmark_custom_assets: run benchmarks with assets assembled into a custom output directory
